name: Championship revenue distribution model
gameplay_effect: Governs how Grand Prix income, television broadcasting revenue, and prize fund money are collected and distributed to participating teams.

name: Backmarker team operating budget (nominal USD)
gameplay_effect: Benchmark annual operating budget for the smallest independent / backmarker entrants in current-year nominal USD.

name: Midfield team operating budget (nominal USD)
gameplay_effect: Benchmark annual operating budget for a competitive midfield team in current-year nominal USD.

name: Front-runner team operating budget (nominal USD)
gameplay_effect: Benchmark annual operating budget for a championship-contending works or top-tier team in current-year nominal USD.

name: Backmarker team operating budget (2025 USD)
gameplay_effect: Benchmark annual operating budget for backmarker entrants adjusted to constant 2025 USD via the US CPI-U index.

name: Midfield team operating budget (2025 USD)
gameplay_effect: Benchmark annual operating budget for a competitive midfield team adjusted to constant 2025 USD via the US CPI-U index.

name: Front-runner team operating budget (2025 USD)
gameplay_effect: Benchmark annual operating budget for a championship-contending team adjusted to constant 2025 USD via the US CPI-U index.

name: Midfield driver salary (nominal USD)
gameplay_effect: Typical annual base retainer paid to an established midfield Formula 1 driver in current-year nominal USD.

name: Top driver salary (nominal USD)
gameplay_effect: Typical annual base retainer commanded by a premier race winner or World Champion driver in current-year nominal USD.

name: Midfield driver salary (2025 USD)
gameplay_effect: Typical annual base retainer paid to an established midfield driver adjusted to constant 2025 USD via the US CPI-U index.

name: Top driver salary (2025 USD)
gameplay_effect: Typical annual base retainer commanded by a premier driver adjusted to constant 2025 USD via the US CPI-U index.

name: Permissibility of commercial livery sponsorship
gameplay_effect: Determines whether cars must carry national racing colours or are allowed to display commercial title sponsors and product branding.

name: Tobacco advertising regulation
gameplay_effect: Controls the legality and restrictions surrounding tobacco company sponsorships, which historically formed the bulk of team commercial revenue.

name: Alcohol advertising regulation
gameplay_effect: Controls restrictions on alcoholic beverage sponsorships at specific rounds, requiring replacement liveries or non-alcoholic brand promotion.

name: New team championship entry mechanism
gameplay_effect: Regulates the institutional process, regulatory barriers, and fee requirements for new entrants seeking to join the grid.

name: Mandatory new entrant fee or bond (nominal USD)
gameplay_effect: Mandatory cash fee, bond deposit, or anti-dilution fund required from a new entrant in nominal USD.

name: Mandatory new entrant fee or bond (2025 USD)
gameplay_effect: Mandatory cash fee or bond required from a new entrant adjusted to constant 2025 USD via the US CPI-U index.

name: Pre-qualifying elimination sessions
gameplay_effect: Controls whether early morning pre-qualifying sessions are staged to eliminate surplus entrants before official practice and qualifying.

name: Maximum starting grid capacity
gameplay_effect: Sets the maximum number of cars permitted to take the start of a Grand Prix.

name: Mandatory chassis structural crash testing
gameplay_effect: Governs mandatory structural impact verification tests required before a new chassis design can be homologated for competition.

name: Trackside emergency medical service standards
gameplay_effect: Dictates the quality and speed of emergency medical response, including medical chase cars, permanent trauma facilities, and helicopter evacuation.

name: Circuit safety infrastructure standards
gameplay_effect: Governs circuit barrier technology, runoff dimensions, and mandatory track safety licensing standards.

name: Head and Neck Support (HANS) device
gameplay_effect: Mandates the HANS head restraint device to drastically mitigate the risk of fatal basilar skull fractures during rapid decelerations.

name: Inherent competition fatality risk level
gameplay_effect: Sets the baseline probability of catastrophic injury or fatal accidents during race weekends, shaping driver safety concerns and public scrutiny.
